summary.text: Jocelyn Kent is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 68, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Randy Chamberlin; there is no incumbent in the race.
She describes herself as a Gallatin Valley native who works as a commercial driver and ski instructor.

paragraphs.text: Jocelyn Kent said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a sixth-generation member of a Gallatin Valley family and grew up at the mouth of Bridger Canyon on a small Black Angus ranch.
She said she works as a class B CDL driver and a ski instructor, and that volunteering on the Belgrade City County Planning Board gave her a passion for community-driven development.
Kent advanced from the Democratic primary for District 68 on June 2, 2026.

In the survey she listed three campaign messages: addressing affordability by supporting a large middle class and working-class people, keeping public lands public, and increasing support for ranchers and farmers.
